abstract: Upwork's Q2 2024 earnings report reveals significant declines in key service categories, with gross services volume in writing falling 33% year-over-year and translation services down 40%. The company is pivoting toward an AI-augmented freelancer model in response to these market shifts.
keyFindings: Gross services volume in writing declined 33% year-over-year in Q2 2024
Translation services experienced a 40% year-over-year decline in Q2 2024
Upwork is shifting its business strategy toward an AI-augmented freelancer model
methodology: Analysis of Upwork Q2 2024 SEC financial filing and earnings report covering the second quarter of 2024.
qualifiers: The excerpt provided is limited; full scope of findings, sample composition, and complete financial context from the full earnings report are not available in the source text provided.
